electricalSimulation.formulation: Modified Nodal Analysis (MNA) with Newton-Raphson nonlinear convergence for diodes/semiconductors.
electricalSimulation.verification: 100% verified across 44 tests in verify_nodal_solver_phase4.ts and nonlinear_electrical_verification.test.ts.

thermalSimulation.formulation: 2D/3D Conductance Network & Conjugate Convective Cooling with multilayer FR4/Cu stackup effective thermal conductivity.
thermalSimulation.verification: 100% verified across spatial thermal verification suites.

structuralSimulation.formulation: 2D Kirchhoff-Love Thin Plate Bending with discrete matrix stiffness [K]{w} = {F}, stress tensor recovery, and static equilibrium checks.
structuralSimulation.verification: 100% verified across Benchmarks S1-S10 (25 assertions in structural_integrity_verification.test.ts).

electrothermalCoupling.formulation: Iterative Picard under-relaxation co-simulation between electrical MNA solver and spatial thermal solver with temperature-dependent resistance R(T) = R0(1 + alpha*(T - T0)).
electrothermalCoupling.verification: 100% verified across electrothermal coupling verification battery (73 tests).

thermomechanicalCoupling.formulation: Structural mechanics and thermal solvers execute independently. Temperature-induced thermal strain expansion epsilon_th = alpha_cte * Delta T is partially defined in material specifications but not coupled into structural load vectors in the production solver loop.
thermomechanicalCoupling.verification: UNSUPPORTED_FOR_COUPLED_SOLVE — Classified as BLOCKED for full thermomechanical feedback until thermal expansion strain vector is integrated into {F}.

canonicalGeometryAndMaterialModels.verification: Deterministic SHA-256 hashing and single source of truth across ecad/mcad/thermal/structural models.

revisionManagementAndInvalidation.verification: Hash-based fingerprinting and cache invalidation on geometry/material mutation.

verificationAndEvidenceGeneration.verification: Cryptographic attestation and evidence manifests tied to canonical model hashes.
